title: Junior IT Support Technician
description: Banks, fintechs (bKash, Nagad), and BPO firms across Dhaka and the Janata Tower IT Village hire entry-level IT support technicians for helpdesk, hardware deployment, and office network maintenance. Bangladesh ICT Division and BASIS list IT support as a priority entry-level pathway. HSC-minimum candidates with basic English are eligible.

title: Garment Production Supervisor
description: BGMEA and BKMEA member factories in Gazipur, Narayanganj, Savar, and the Chittagong Export Processing Zone (CEPZ) recruit production line supervisors. Strong demand for women supervisors who can mentor predominantly female sewing lines. Tailoring or sewing experience plus SSC-level literacy qualifies candidates; BTEB short courses on line balancing and quality control accelerate promotion.

title: Microfinance Loan Officer
description: BRAC, Grameen Bank, ASA, and other Microcredit Regulatory Authority (MRA) licensed MFIs recruit field-level loan officers across rural Bangladesh to manage borrower groups, disburse working-capital loans, and collect repayments. Bachelor's degree required by MRA prudential rules. Strong rural posting demand including Khulna division.

title: Home Tailoring Business
description: Rural and peri-urban women across Khulna, Jessore, and Satkhira run home-based tailoring businesses producing salwar kameez, school uniforms, and contract piecework for local boutiques. BRAC and PKSF micro-loans (10,000–50,000 BDT) finance an electric sewing machine and starter fabric stock. A skilled tailor with a steady customer base earns 8,000–25,000 BDT monthly; a clear progression path into BGMEA factory supervisor roles exists.

title: bKash / Nagad Mobile Money Agent
description: bKash, Nagad, and Rocket sub-agent networks let youth operate kiosks earning commissions on cash-in, cash-out, mobile recharge, and bill payments. Float capital of about 25,000–50,000 BDT is required. Bangladesh Bank reports mobile financial services penetration above 60% of adults (2024). Well-suited to small shops in upazila bazaars across Khulna and other rural divisions.

title: Poultry / Dairy Smallholder
description: Department of Livestock Services (DLS) and BRAC livestock programmes support backyard layer/broiler poultry units (200–500 birds) and 2–4 cow dairy operations across rural Khulna, Jessore, and Bagerhat. Combined with rice farming, it diversifies household income and is a documented pathway out of agricultural poverty. PKSF and BRAC offer working-capital loans plus vaccination support.

title: Pathao / Foodpanda Rider
description: Ride-hailing and food-delivery platforms Pathao, Uber, and Foodpanda operate at scale in Dhaka and Chittagong. A rider with a BRTA-licensed motorcycle (own or rented from Pathao Pay) clears 10,000–20,000 BDT monthly after fuel and platform commission. Income peaks during Ramadan iftar deliveries and monsoon evenings.

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description: Bangladesh is the world's second-largest source of registered freelancers (a2i/ICT Division 2024 figures). Designers serving Upwork, Fiverr, and local SME clients via Facebook produce flyers, social posts, and logos using Canva or Adobe Express. Self-taught youth across all 64 districts can earn 5,000–35,000 BDT monthly depending on portfolio quality and client base.

title: BRAC Skills Development Programme
description: BRAC's Skills Development Programme (SDP) — the largest NGO-run TVET network globally — runs 3-6 month courses in tailoring and sewing machine operation, garment quality control, mobile financial services agency, and electrical wiring. Target trainees are rural youth and women with primary or no formal education. Graduates receive job-placement support into BGMEA/BKMEA member factories and certification recognised by BTEB.

title: a2i Skills4Future Digital Programme
title_local: a2i স্কিলস ফর ফিউচার ডিজিটাল প্রোগ্রাম
description: Aspire to Innovate (a2i) — the Prime Minister's Office digital initiative co-funded by UNDP — runs the Skills4Future programme delivering free online and in-person courses on freelancing, digital marketing, data entry, and entry-level software engineering. Delivered through 8,000+ Union Digital Centres across rural Bangladesh, including Khulna division. HSC-minimum admission with English literacy assessment.
